messages:
alex_cs: PaperTrail reported a regression after our recent quant profile rollout — answers now often omit named entities in summaries, especially org names. They pasted a repro. Can we triage? Rollout id noted below. :rotating_light:

alex_cs (customer paste): \"prompt: Summarize the following incident report and list affected orgs:\n\n'Our service crashed for Redwood Inference and PaperTrail clients due to a config error...'\"

alex_cs: Before (profile v2.1): \"Affected orgs: Redwood Inference, PaperTrail Inc.\"
After (profile v3.0-int8-fp8): \"Affected orgs:\"  <-- empty

alex_cs: Repro curl (customer):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \\
  -d '{"model":"r-infer-ggml-13b","input":"Summarize the incident and list affected orgs","max_tokens":200}'
```

alex_cs: Customer says this began immediately after we rolled 'quant-profile-2026-03-15' to their dedicated pool. They reported 3 examples where org tokens were dropped or replaced with generic placeholders.

maria_eng_ml: Can you attach the exact request IDs or a sample request blob? Also need the quant profile hash and runtime kernel version. Did we change symmetric/asymmetric rounding or per-channel scaling in that profile?

felix_oncall: Noted. Rollout metadata: rollout_id=r-prod-quant-2026-03-15, profile_hash=abc123ef, runtime=rdw-runtime-v4.2. Change log: switched calibration from percentile-based to min-max for a subset of embedding/softmax ops and tightened per-tensor clipping.

maria_eng_ml: That clipping change could compress low-probability tokens to 0 probability. I suspect entity tokens with sparse occurrences are being quantized to underflow. Please provide logits for the prompt (topk/top_p) or the raw token probs if the customer can share request IDs.

deploy-bot: [deployment] rollout r-prod-quant-2026-03-15 applied to dedicated pool papertrail-dedicated-7 | success

alex_cs: I'll grab the customer's request IDs and ask them to run the same request with `profile=profile_v2.1` to confirm the delta. For immediate mitigation — can we pin their pool to the previous profile?

felix_oncall: Yes, we can pin their pool to the previous profile. Kicking off rollback now as a temporary mitigation. Will post job id when complete. :white_check_mark:

jess_product: Keep me in the loop. If rollback fixes it we need customer comms + a postmortem. Also verify whether any hosted customers share the same profile and might be impacted.

maria_eng_ml: After rollback we should run the NER/Entity-retention eval suite against both profiles and measure token-level KL and per-token probability drops. I'll also add a regression test that asserts entity token retention across our eval prompts. I'll start a small repro harness.

alex_cs: Thanks — I'll update PaperTrail once rollback completes and collect logs. Assigning follow-up: @maria_eng_ml to run evals, @felix_oncall to confirm rollback, @jess_product for comms.

felix_oncall: rollback job id: rj-20260315-9934, completed at 1848004389.

alex_cs: Rollback confirmed by customer — entities restored in the sample. They requested root-cause and an SLA credit. I'll open a support case and escalate billing.

maria_eng_ml: I'll upload findings to the incident board and open a bug to adjust clipping heuristics and calibration fallback. Also adding a guard that refuses profiles that zero out low-frequency token ranges. :memo:

alex_cs: Thanks team. Closing interim thread, will post final postmortem link here once ready. :pray:
